Title: Azure Monitor Alerts for Azure Backup is in public preview

Body.Content:
You can now manage backup-related alerts via the standard Azure Monitor experience for alert management. 

This integration helps users have a consistent experience for alert management across different Azure services, including backup. With Azure Monitor alerts, users can now route alerts to any notification channel supported by Azure Monitor such as email, ITSM, Webhook, Logic App etc.

Currently, this feature is supported for the following workloads: Azure Databases for PostgreSQL server, Azure Blobs and Azure Managed Disks. Support for other workloads will be added in the near future. Alerts are currently generated for security-related scenarios and job failure scenarios, with more enhancements planned in the short term.

Learn more.
